cohort: The study included 676 women with symptomatic uterine fibroids who wished to become pregnant and underwent either USgHIFU or LM.
finding: Compared with laparoscopic myomectomy (LM), USgHIFU ablation significantly shortened the time to pregnancy, although pregnancy rates were similar between the two procedures.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean delivery was lower in the USgHIFU group (41.6%) than in the LM group (54.9%).
